description: Groups of functions forming a subsystem.

entries.name: <subsystem>
evidence: EXAMPLE, replace: 12 functions share one vtable and one 16-byte state block
entries.hypothesis: EXAMPLE: a coherent subsystem rather than a coincidence of adjacency in the binary
entries.confidence_basis: sharing a data block is suggestive; adjacency in a binary is weak evidence, because the linker decides that
entries.next_test: confirm the grouping with a call trace: do these functions call each other in one phase of the frame?
entries.notes: Grouping by name similarity alone is not evidence.
